atmosphere: A city street at midday where movement is constant but not chaotic, with the quiet certainty of a tool deployed without fanfare
material_language: Matte black polymer with subtle tactile ridges, contrasted against worn urban textures: concrete, brushed metal, weathered fabric
lighting_intent: Direct daylight with soft fill, casting clean shadows that define form and motion without flattening the scene

narrative_elements.element: A hand releasing the battery from a neck strap in mid-motion
narrative_elements.reason: The gesture embodies the verified distinctive lever of detaching the battery as a reflex, directly tied to the cordon tour de cou functionality

narrative_elements.element: A faint arc of the USB-C cable unfurling toward an out-of-frame device
narrative_elements.reason: It visualises the integrated cable deployment without naming or showing the competing device, reinforcing the ‘system’ aspect of verified features

narrative_elements.element: A digital display glowing with a clear numerical charge indicator
narrative_elements.reason: It confirms the verified presence of the screen and its utility, anchoring the moment of reliability in the emotional intent of calm certainty

permitted_secondary_elements: A blurred figure in motion behind the action, suggesting urban flow without distraction
A textured pavement edge grounding the gesture in real space
A sliver of a public bench armrest implying transit context
forbidden_decorative_noise: beige, crème, cream, sable, sand, écru, taupe, ivory, heart, leaf, foliage, eucalyptus, fern, petal, gold, glitter, marble, velvet, bokeh
any object resembling a phone, screen, case, or packaging
logos, labels, price tags, watermarks, or typographic overlays on surfaces
decorative patterns, ornamental frames, or symbolic motifs unrelated to utility
static arrangements, posed subjects, or staged still-life compositions
rationale: The art direction channels the verified distinctiveness—the neck strap, digital screen, and integrated cable—into a single flowing gesture within layered urban depth, ensuring the product remains the elevated hero while every element serves the story of reliable reconnection.
